rows.note: Use 班 for the group of students taught together, rather than for the course or an individual lesson.

example.english: Our class has an exam next week.
example.traditional: 我哋班下個星期要考試。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baan1 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jiu3 haau2 si3

rows.note: Use 課 for a subject course such as 烹飪課 or for one lesson in a series, rather than for the student group.

example.english: I have a cooking class today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 tong4 paang1 jam6 fo3

rows.note: Use 類 as the all-purpose noun for a category or type.

example.english: I usually don't watch this class of movies.
example.jyutping: nei1 leoi6 din6 jing2 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 m4 tai2

rows.note: Use 階級 specifically for a social class based on wealth, occupation, or status.

example.english: They shouldn't discriminate against people because of class.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔應該因為階級而歧視人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 jan1 wai6 gaai1 kap1 ji4 kei4 si6 jan4
